A note on scope, so nobody spends effort on something that will not land.

Chargle plays a sound when the charger goes in and another when it comes out. It
is meant to stay a small tray app that does one thing. Requests that fit that
shape, like new sound packs, more control over the on-screen panel, or better
behaviour around quiet hours, are very welcome.

Things it is unlikely to grow: battery health analytics, charging history,
scheduling, anything that needs an account, and anything that needs a network
connection. The app makes no network requests at all, and keeping it that way is
a deliberate feature rather than an oversight.
